author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Has Adam Savage updated his adhesive tape storage, and what's his favorite tape? How long does it take for Adam to determine if a shop infrastructure change he's made actually works for him? What shop addition has Adam made that he didn't know he needed? Has Adam ever been frustrated by a client having a lower bar than his own for what looks “good enough?" In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members BrainSkraps, philredbeard, Inigo566 and Thomas Esson, whom we thank for their support!
